answers.question: What is the average edispl of the cars of model volvo?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT AVG(edispl) FROM cars_data WHERE id IN (SELECT makeid FROM car_names WHERE model = 'volvo')

answers.question: What is the average edispl for all volvos?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT AVG(cdispl) FROM cars_data c INNER JOIN car_names cn ON c.id = cn.makeid INNER JOIN car_names cn2 ON cn.makeid = cn2.makeid WHERE cn.model = 'VOLVO'

answers.question: What is the maximum accelerate for different number of cylinders?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT cylinders, MAX(accelerate) as max_accelerate FROM cars_data GROUP BY cylinders

answers.question: In 1980, how many cars were made?
What are the names and ids of all makers with more than 3 models?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT id, maker FROM car_makers WHERE id IN (SELECT maker FROM model_list GROUP BY maker HAVING COUNT(*) > 3)

answers.question: What are the different models created by either the car maker General Motors or weighed more than 3500?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT DISTINCT MODEL FROM CAR_NAMES WHERE MAKEID IN (SELECT ID FROM CAR_MAKERS WHERE MAKER = 'GM') OR ID IN (SELECT ID FROM CARS_DATA WHERE WEIGHT > 3500)
